patches.title: Reject submodule filesystem paths outside the repository

dep3.origin: Adapted from upstream commit 419637d3587396f5d139d6d88480eab3cd81e7a1 for libgit2 0.28.4.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed baseline resolves the malicious submodule path and creates the configured subrepository outside its worktree, inside an isolated temporary parent.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed patched package rejects the path with GIT_EINVALID and creates no directory outside its worktree.

patches.title: Bound declared object size while unpacking pack data

dep3.origin: Adapted from upstream commit c1896f06df22cc0ca5658df3a8f6cd7ede4cd6ae; the cap is checked in pack unpacking so binary patch APIs keep their prior behavior.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact installed baseline accepts the 150-byte pack carrying a declared 100 MiB delta result.
tests.patchedExpectation: The exact installed patched package rejects the object at a 42 MiB configured cap before allocating the declared result.

tests.baselineExpectation: Binary patch application succeeds with the default settings.
tests.patchedExpectation: A 16-byte binary patch succeeds while the pack object size cap is set to one byte.

patches.title: Pass redirected server URL to the credential callback

dep3.origin: Adapted from upstream commit c1507abc44647b3acd832a33a5b1c8c9f5ba8821 for the Focal HTTP transport.

tests.baselineExpectation: After a localhost HTTP redirect, the credentials callback receives the original endpoint's origin.
tests.patchedExpectation: After a localhost HTTP redirect, the credentials callback receives the redirected origin and the test sends no credentials.
